N Corp.'s order, its rules, and its Canned Experience ensure that its feathers can live without much worry.
N公司的秩序、规则和经验罐头，可以让羽们不用那么烦恼地生活。

But the world outside provides us no real respite.
但对我们而言，外面并不是多么好的休憩之地。

What awaits us out there isn't a place where life is lived. Just a pinning board of humans who are categorized, designated, and nailed on display.
那里并不是用于生活的地方，只是被分类、固定的人们用于展示自身的地方。

But here, people will feel how absurd and discomforting it all is.
但在这里……人们将会感受到这种荒诞与不悦。

Do you see now?
明白吗？
Finally, finally, people will have to live in the world seen through your eyes. 以后，人们就能去适应你所看见的世界了！

It doesn't even need to be a tool for N Corp. to produce Canned Experiences anymore.
甚至再也不用成为N公司生产经验罐头的方式。

This whole thing can become a beautiful sailing ship for the two of us, floating, roaming the world. No more rewinding. They can all live here, freely, and in forms of their own choosing... Living in a world whose meaningfulness we define! 这一切本身，会成为我们美丽的小船……能漂流、游荡。不再会倒放。他们可以在这里一直自由地生活下去。以自己所期望的姿态，在我们创造的意义之中生活下去！

We can do this... together. Two lonely, kindred souls who understand each other.
如果你和我一起……就能做到哦。毕竟我们是能彼此相互理解，志同道合的唯一伴侣。

Oh, just thinking about it makes my heart rush. Doesn't yours?
啊，光是想象……不就令人心潮澎湃吗？

... But we will still be afraid.
……即便如此，也依旧会感到恐惧吧。

No, we won't.
不，不会恐惧的。

This Sisyphe would be our creation... and we can do whatever we want with it.
这西西弗……是我们创造的，也是我们所能做到的。

And with that freedom, Sisyphe will finally become a world with true raison d'être.
在那样的自由之中，西西弗将会重生为一个具有明确存在理由的世界。

A world that was once so alienating to us... will no longer be just a superfluous world of random contingencies.
曾令我们感到疏离的世界……再也不会毫无理由地放下什么。

Jeanne... The world does not change. Therefore, it is unreasonable and indifferent to our existences.
让娜……世界绝不会改变。因此它才不合常理，才对我们漠不关心。

That Cinéma Sisyphe, created in your design...
将如你所言被创造出的西西弗影院……

... will still be an alienating thing, a place reaved of freedom, only wearing the façade of familiarity.
只会变成被剥夺了自由……以熟悉的事物替换而成的陌生的事物而已。
... But I will be free. To me, it will be a place of comfort and succor. ……可那对我而言就是自由。会让我觉得舒适，安稳。

Ma puce, do you think I'm wrong?
小可爱。你是不是觉得……我错了？

I am afraid... to judge what is right and wrong.
我……对判断正误感到恐惧。

Not the only thing you're afraid of, is it?
就只是这样？

You know we can't fly, Meursault. Outside Sisyphe, out there, you're going to plummet.
默尔索，我们不能飞。在外面，你会向下坠落的。

Yes. And it will come to me as a slow descent, even as I feel the weight that is attached to me.
是啊。如果感受到那重负，我或许会逐渐坠落吧。

Fear and vertigo will set in as I fall.
而在坠落时，我或许会感到恐惧与晕眩吧。

And the clear meaning of existence will remain opaque to me, even as I draw my last breath.
直到死亡降临的那天……我或许也终究无法知晓存在的确切意义吧。

It is my responsibility to steer the direction of my flow, to choose what I can keep and what I must surrender.
我也有责任确定我要如何漂流，要选择什么，要放弃什么。

So, I refuse to follow that Voice. I will not... walk with you.
所以，我不会遵从那道声音。也不会……和你一同前行。

And you're fine with this life, where you're always on a crash course with other people? Feeling that excruciating pain of collision every second of your life?
你是想在与他人的冲突中生活下去吗？想忍耐着那如死亡般的痛苦，直到死亡来临的那一刻？

Yes. Like this waltz, there are inevitable differences between your understanding and mine.
没错。正如我们跳着的华尔兹那样，你我理解的事物必定存在差异。

But I will keep on colliding, dancing to the rhythm, making adjustments, reciprocating their movements.
但我们仍然能感受着节拍，彼此不断地碰撞。不断地去修正，去调整。

They'll laugh at you. You'll live a life that is a constant stream of embarrassments because we don't know how or what we need to adjust, or where to even begin.
你连哪儿要改正都不清楚。哪怕花上一辈子去调整，也只会是一副滑稽模样吧。

And we never will.
此后也不会清楚吧。

But not knowing will not stop me from trying.
可不清楚并不能阻止我去调整。

... You're leaving me again.
……所以你又想要离开我。
